title: Resend SDK showcase
description: A centred icon tile and lit title with a violet last word, a row of square hairline SDK tiles (the chosen one brightens, its icon violet), and a wide 24px-radius code panel: framework tabs, a copy button, numbered monospace code with violet strings, and small footer links. A light streak runs along the panel's top edge. On phones the tiles and tabs scroll sideways.
notes: choosing a tile or tab swaps the code (React state)
the icon tile is a media slot (a looping video in the original)
name: resend-integrate

props.name: accent
props.description: the last words, in the accent colour

props.name: text
props.description: the lead; a list sets its desktop line breaks

props.name: media
props.description: fills the icon slot above the title; empty shows a placeholder tile

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: label of the copy button, for screen readers

props.name: links
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon?: ReactNode; }[]
props.description: small links in the panel's footer (the first stays on phones)
